mismatch.message: unsupported hero command: an unported branch of this command: monsterObject is not available

summary: When a wizard creates a mimic through Genesis or the wizard-mode create-monster prompt, makemon.c:makemon() calls set_mimic_sym(), which can create a temporary disguise object with mkobj(). JavaScript passes create_particular_creation() a bare monster-creation environment, so a statue or figurine disguise reaches obj.js without the existing monsterObject lifecycle hook and stops before the next turn. The source-matched fix is to supply the standard objectGenerationEnv at that production makemon call.

source.branch: create_particular_creation() creates a named S_MIMIC; makemon() enters its S_MIMIC arm, and set_mimic_sym() selects a random object class for an ordinary-room disguise. When mkobj() produces a STATUE or FIGURINE, JavaScript must run the residual monster-object initialize/finalize behavior just as C mksobj() does before set_mimic_sym() reads the temporary object type and frees it.
callers: read.c:create_particular() (3372-3405) calls create_particular_creation(); wizcmds.c:wiz_genesis() (203-210) calls create_particular() for the direct Ctrl-G/#wizgenesis entry.

makemon.c:create_critters() (1556-1574) calls create_particular() when wizard mode and !neverask; active production callers include read.c:seffect_create_monster() (1607-1619) and zap.c:weffects() for WAN_CREATE_MONSTER (2569-2573). JS wiring is makemon.js:create_critters() and read.js:seffect_create_monster().

makemon.c:makemon() (1303-1306) calls set_mimic_sym() for S_MIMIC; makemon.c:set_mimic_sym() (2393-2509) calls mkobj(), consumes otmp->otyp, and obfree()s the temporary object. JS equivalents are makemon_create.js:makemon() and set_mimic_sym().

mkobj.c:mkobj()/mksobj_init() build the temporary object. JavaScript obj.js routes statue/figurine initialization through initializeResidualMonsterObject(); object_generation.js:objectGenerationEnv() already supplies the monsterObject implementation.
dependencies: makemon.c:makemon() is already ported for this explicit runtime species call and returns the monster consumed by create_particular_creation().
makemon.c:set_mimic_sym() is already ported as a whole function; its mkobj()/obfree() return and cleanup order match C.
mkobj.c:mkobj() and mksobj_init() are already ported; their statue/figurine lifecycle requires the monsterObject hook.
objectGenerationEnv() is the existing JS composition point for object-construction hooks, including monsterObject.

evidence: Saved combined queue SHA-256 e153a1e0869be21cb7a70ad69de92d64fced50b7a39196a9515a6760416d7d0d selects synthetic/v39/v39-counted-wizgenesis-mimic-population; after the accepted B209 counted-dispatch fix, the immutable recipe matches 94/114 screens and first stops at step 94 with “monsterObject is not available”.

Focused fresh C differential `node scripts/diff-fresh.mjs challenges/cases/v39/v39-lockpick-mimic-door-west.recipe.session.json` (run-ANLf80) records C=114 screens/6551 RNG and JavaScript=94 screens/6232 RNG; the next missing source draw is C rn2(3)=0 at rndmonst_adj(makemon.c:1716), step 95, after the JS boundary.

Direct JavaScript runSegment() replay of the same independent recipe stops with UnsupportedHeroCommandBoundaryError from cmd.js:failClosedCommand(), message “an unported branch of this command: monsterObject is not available”, after 94 screens and 6232 RNG calls.

C source trace: read.c:create_particular_creation() calls makemon(whichpm, u.ux, u.uy, mmflags) at read.c:3315; makemon.c:makemon() calls set_mimic_sym() at 1303-1306; set_mimic_sym() calls mkobj() and reads otmp->otyp at 2505-2508. In an ordinary room the source symbol table at makemon.c:2388-2391 includes ROCK_CLASS, whose selected object may be a statue or figurine.

JavaScript source trace: read.js:create_particular_creation() passes only `{ state, _createParticular: true }` to makemon_runtime() at 3570-3573. makemon_create.js:creationEnv() preserves hooks but does not add object-generation hooks; set_mimic_sym() passes that bare normalized environment to mkobj() at 1029-1031; obj.js:initializeResidualMonsterObject() requires env.hooks.monsterObject at 2020-2021. object_generation.js:objectGenerationEnv() already composes the exact adapter at lines 20-64.

The common create_particular() caller is reachable both directly from wizcmds.c:wiz_genesis() and through makemon.c:create_critters() from the wizard create-monster scroll/spell and WAN_CREATE_MONSTER paths. Applying objectGenerationEnv at create_particular_creation() preserves source branch order while fixing the shared object constructor dependency.
